definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine that deals with the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of diseases and injuries in animals. Also covers public health aspects such as food safety and zoonotic disease control.

examples.japanese: {獣医学|じゅういがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{獣医学|じゅういがく}{部|ぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧6{年制|ねんせい}です。
examples.english: The veterinary medicine department is a six-year program.

examples.japanese: {獣医学|じゅういがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}している→貢献する：21682_koukensuru⟧。
examples.english: Research in veterinary medicine contributes not only to animal health but also to measures against infectious diseases in humans.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{獣医|じゅうい}→獣医：07031_juui⟧ (veterinarian) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study, science). In Japan, veterinary programs are six-year undergraduate courses at universities, unlike the postgraduate model common in the US.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {獣医学|じゅういがく}{部|ぶ}: veterinary medicine department/faculty
- {獣医学|じゅういがく}{科|か}: veterinary science course
- {獣医学|じゅういがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧: veterinary research
- {獣医学|じゅういがく}⟦{博士|はかせ}→博士：03551_hakase⟧: Doctor of Veterinary Medicine
